subroutines.name: plot_sprite
subroutines.title: Plot a sprite
subroutines.description: Copy sprite sprite_number to the screen with its top-left corner at byte column plot_x, pixel row plot_y. The sprite tables give the address of its data and its size; the data is stored row by row, sprite_width bytes to a row, and is written over the screen contents without masking. The screen is laid out like MODE 2 with 640-byte character rows from &3000, so successive bytes of a sprite row are 8 bytes apart, and each pixel row starts one byte below the last, or 640-7 bytes on when it crosses into the next character row.

subroutines.name: screen_address
subroutines.title: Calculate a screen address
subroutines.description: Set screen_ptr to the screen address of byte column plot_x on pixel row plot_y: &3000 + 640 x (plot_y DIV 8) + (plot_y MOD 8) + 8 x plot_x. The multiplication by 640 is done with a table inside MOS 1.20 (mos_row_offsets), so this only works with that MOS.

subroutines.name: wrch_handler
subroutines.title: WRCHV handler: print letters and digits in the game font
subroutines.description: Installed on WRCHV while the game runs. A letter (either case) or a digit is printed in the game's own font: its eight-byte glyph is copied over the definition of character 128 (user_char_128) and character 128 is printed instead. Every other character is printed unchanged. Both paths finish in the MOS 1.20 OSWRCH routine at mos_oswrch_default, jumped to directly rather than through the WRCHV value saved at start-up.

subroutines.name: add_thousand_points
subroutines.title: Add 1000 to a hero's score
subroutines.description: Advance the thousands digit of hero X's score. When it passes 9 it goes back to 0 and the ten-thousands digit, kept separately as one of the small digit sprites, goes up (to at most 9); that digit is then drawn below the score, with four further small sprites beside it.

subroutines.name: add_thousand_points_joystick
subroutines.title: Add 1000 to a hero's score
subroutines.description: Advance the thousands digit of hero X's score. When it passes 9 it goes back to 0 and the ten-thousands digit, kept separately as one of the small digit sprites, goes up (to at most 9); that digit is then drawn below the score, with four further small sprites beside it.

subroutines.name: reset_hero
subroutines.title: Give a hero their starting attributes
subroutines.description: Set hero X's missile limit, missile damage and damage taken from the starting tables, and their score to zero. The units digit is set one below 0 because draw_status_panel draws the score by adding a point.

subroutines.name: draw_status_panel
subroutines.title: Draw the status panel
subroutines.description: Draw each hero's section of the status panel to the right of the views: health and score (by taking a health point and adding a score point, from starting values one beyond those wanted), face, shield and armour rating, one icon per missile allowed, and missile damage.

subroutines.name: plot_panel_sprite
subroutines.title: Plot a sprite in a hero's panel section
subroutines.description: Plot sprite A at byte column X and pixel row Y + hero_panel_y - 14 for the hero being drawn (draw_status_panel's loop counter).

on_entry.Y: row within the hero's panel section

subroutines.name: lose_health_point
subroutines.title: Take one health point from a hero
subroutines.description: If hero X is in play, take one from their health and redraw it. When it falls below 00 the hero dies: their sprite is erased, they leave play, and their number joins returning_hero_queue.

subroutines.name: add_point
subroutines.title: Add one point to a hero's score
subroutines.description: Add one to hero X's score, carrying into the higher digits, and redraw it.

subroutines.name: add_ten_points
subroutines.title: Add ten points to a hero's score
subroutines.description: Add ten to hero X's score, carrying into the higher digits, and redraw it.

subroutines.name: point_at_boots_icon
subroutines.title: Set the position of a hero's boots icon
subroutines.description: Set plot_x and plot_y to the place in hero X's panel section that shows the lightning bolt for Boots of Speed.

subroutines.name: plot_boots_icon
subroutines.title: Show a hero's boots icon
subroutines.description: Plot the lightning bolt at plot_x, plot_y.

subroutines.name: erase_boots_icon
subroutines.title: Remove a hero's boots icon
subroutines.description: Plot the blank sprite over the lightning bolt at plot_x, plot_y.

subroutines.name: hero_menu
subroutines.title: Choose the heroes and the sound
subroutines.description: Clear the left of the screen, print the menu and let the players toggle each hero (keys 1-4) and the sound (5 on, 6 off). SPACE starts the game if at least one hero is playing.

subroutines.name: hero_menu_joystick
subroutines.title: Choose the heroes and the sound
subroutines.description: Clear the left of the screen, print the menu and let the players toggle each hero (keys 1-4) and the sound (5 on, 6 off). SPACE starts the game if at least one hero is playing.

subroutines.name: print_menu
subroutines.title: Print the menu text
subroutines.description: Print the sixteen positioned strings of menu_text.

subroutines.name: print_menu_joystick
subroutines.title: Print the menu text
subroutines.description: Print the sixteen positioned strings of menu_text.

subroutines.name: print_menu_string
subroutines.title: Print one menu string
subroutines.description: Move the text cursor to the column and row in the two bytes at menu_text+Y, then print the following characters up to and including a carriage return.

on_entry.Y: offset of the string in menu_text

subroutines.name: print_menu_string_joystick
subroutines.title: Print one menu string
subroutines.description: Move the text cursor to the column and row in the two bytes at menu_text+Y, then print the following characters up to and including a carriage return.

on_entry.Y: offset of the string in menu_text

subroutines.name: set_menu_no
subroutines.title: Change a menu entry to NO
subroutines.description: Write "NO " at menu_text+Y.

subroutines.name: set_menu_no_joystick
subroutines.title: Change a menu entry to NO
subroutines.description: Write "NO " at menu_text+Y.

subroutines.name: set_menu_yes
subroutines.title: Change a menu entry to YES
subroutines.description: Write "YES" at menu_text+Y.

subroutines.name: set_menu_yes_joystick
subroutines.title: Change a menu entry to YES
subroutines.description: Write "YES" at menu_text+Y.

subroutines.name: set_menu_off_joystick
subroutines.title: Change the sound entry to OFF
subroutines.description: Write "FF" at menu_text+Y, after its "O".

on_entry.Y: offset of the entry's second character

subroutines.description: Write "N " at menu_text+Y, after its "O".

on_entry.Y: offset of the entry's second character

subroutines.name: set_menu_on_joystick
subroutines.title: Change the sound entry to ON
subroutines.description: Write "N " at menu_text+Y, after its "O".

on_entry.Y: offset of the entry's second character

subroutines.name: remove_absent_heroes
subroutines.title: Take the heroes nobody plays out of the game
subroutines.description: Draw any ten-thousands score digits, then put every hero switched off on the menu out of play, with a &64 entry in returning_hero_queue in their place.

subroutines.name: remove_absent_heroes_joystick
subroutines.title: Take the heroes nobody plays out of the game
subroutines.description: Draw any ten-thousands score digits, then put every hero switched off on the menu out of play, with a &64 entry in returning_hero_queue in their place.

subroutines.name: reset_workspace
subroutines.title: Reset the game workspace for a new level
subroutines.description: Copy workspace_template into page &0D and clear the per-level state.

subroutines.name: draw_view_frames
subroutines.title: Draw the frames round the four views
subroutines.description: With the MOS's own text output restored, send the twenty PLOT commands of view_frame_plots, draw the four views, then put the game's WRCHV handler back.

subroutines.name: unpack_level
subroutines.title: Copy the loaded level into the game's tables
subroutines.description: Distribute the level file at &6B00 into the object, door, key, trapdoor and map tables and the wall sprite.

subroutines.name: reset_monsters
subroutines.title: Clear the monsters for a new level
subroutines.description: Mark every monster as not yet appeared, give each the level's starting hit points, and clear the heroes' keys and the returning_hero_queue.

subroutines.name: clear_text_area
subroutines.title: Clear the left of the screen
subroutines.description: Set a text window over the left of the screen and clear it.

subroutines.name: check_for_victory
subroutines.title: Check whether the Chalice has been found
subroutines.description: On level 25, if a hero stands on the cell where the Chalice is, play the victory sequence, print the ending message, wait for a key and reset the machine through the RESET vector. The message is not part of the program: it is the 140 bytes at room_walls + &3A followed by the string at object_free_map + &3A, which on level 25 hold the ending text instead of map data.

subroutines.name: victory_sequence
subroutines.title: Play the victory sequence
subroutines.description: Spin sprites round the Chalice with a rising tone, then dissolve it.

subroutines.name: draw_victory_ring
subroutines.title: Draw the ring of sprites round the Chalice
subroutines.description: Plot the current victory sprite at the twelve cells round the Chalice, changing sprite as it goes.

subroutines.name: plot_victory_sprite
subroutines.title: Plot a victory sprite at a cell
subroutines.description: Plot the current victory sprite at the map cell in &80, &81.

subroutines.name: next_victory_sprite
subroutines.title: Choose the next victory sprite
subroutines.description: Step the victory sprite through &16-&19.

on_exit.victory_sprite: the next sparkle, &16-&19 in turn; &15 (erasing) is kept

subroutines.name: dissolve_chalice
subroutines.title: Clear a random byte of the Chalice
subroutines.description: Use the System VIA timer to pick a byte of the Chalice sprite, clear it, and redraw the Chalice.

subroutines.name: plot_chalice
subroutines.title: Plot the Chalice
subroutines.description: Plot the Chalice sprite at its place on the map.

subroutines.name: update_game
subroutines.title: Run one frame of play
subroutines.description: Move the heroes, open doors for heroes carrying the right key, pick up and swap keys, then draw the objects, move the missiles and the monsters, and handle the pause key.

subroutines.name: hero_enters_exit
subroutines.title: Start a hero going down the exit
subroutines.description: Play the exit sound, restore any hero shrunk before, and start the animation of hero X spinning and shrinking on the exit. Ends by jumping to play_level rather than returning.

subroutines.name: restore_hero_sprites
subroutines.title: Restore a hero's sprite sizes
subroutines.description: Put back the width and height of all eight of hero X's sprites, which the exit animation shrinks.

subroutines.name: drop_key
subroutines.title: Drop the key a hero carries
subroutines.description: Put hero X's key in a free cell next to them, and remove it from their panel section.

subroutines.name: find_open_neighbour
subroutines.title: Find a free cell next to a cell
subroutines.description: Starting with cell_x, cell_y, try the cells above, to the right, below and to the left, and leave cell_x, cell_y at the first without a wall.

on_exit.cell_x: x of the first free neighbour, trying above, right and below; otherwise the cell to the left, unchecked
on_exit.Y: 0 if a free neighbour was found

subroutines.name: queue_exit_marker
subroutines.title: Sound the exit and add a queue marker
subroutines.description: Play the exit sound and put a &64 entry in the first free slot of returning_hero_queue.

subroutines.name: move_heroes
subroutines.title: Move the heroes
subroutines.description: For each hero in play: continue a step between cells, or read the hero's keys (and, for heroes 0 and 1, the magic key) and start a step or fire a missile; check the new cell for walls, monsters, other heroes and objects, change view when the hero enters another room, and draw the hero.

subroutines.name: start_hero_step
subroutines.title: Start a hero's step between cells
subroutines.description: Set hero X's step counter to 1 and their pixel offsets for the direction they face: 6 rows up or down, or 2 byte columns left or right.

subroutines.name: continue_hero_step
subroutines.title: Continue a hero's step between cells
subroutines.description: Toggle hero X's animation frame and count down their step. When it ends, move the hero one cell in the direction they face and clear the pixel offsets. The offsets are then doubled.

subroutines.name: animate_absent_hero
subroutines.title: Animate a hero who is out of play
subroutines.description: Every other frame, step hero_frame by hero_offset_x through hero_appearance_sprites and plot the sprite at the hero's cell: forwards (+1) for a hero dying, stopping at the skull; backwards (-1) for a hero returning through a Cross of Resurrection. When a returning hero reaches the first sprite, put them in play facing down with health 32 (set to 33 and drawn by taking a point).

subroutines.name: draw_hero
subroutines.title: Draw a hero
subroutines.description: Plot sprite_number at hero X's cell and pixel offset in every view that shows it.

subroutines.name: get_hero_cell
subroutines.title: Copy a hero's position to cell_x, cell_y

subroutines.name: draw_objects
subroutines.title: Draw the level's objects
subroutines.description: Plot each of objects 30 to 1 at its cell in every view that shows it, with no pixel offset.

subroutines.name: collect_objects
subroutines.title: Pick up the object in a hero's cell
subroutines.description: Find the object at hero X's cell and act on it: score, health, teleport, resurrection, energy drain, or one of the magic items.

subroutines.name: play_pickup_sound
subroutines.title: Play the pickup sound
subroutines.description: Define the pickup envelope and play the pickup sound, from the OSWORD parameter blocks at &192C and &193A.

subroutines.name: move_missiles
subroutines.title: Move the missiles
subroutines.description: Advance every missile in flight one cell. A missile stops at a wall, damages a monster or hero it meets, and bounces back off an energy drainer, wearing it down.

subroutines.name: flip_firer_frame
subroutines.title: Animate the hero who fired a missile
subroutines.description: Toggle the animation frame of the hero whose missile is in slot X.

subroutines.name: credit_missile_owner
subroutines.title: Give a point to the hero who fired a missile

subroutines.name: draw_all_views
subroutines.title: Draw all four views
subroutines.description: Draw the room each hero's view shows.

subroutines.name: show_hero_room
subroutines.title: Show the room a hero has moved into
subroutines.description: Set hero X's view to the room containing their cell and redraw that view.

subroutines.name: draw_view_0
subroutines.title: Draw the top-left view
subroutines.description: Draw the room in hero 0's view.

subroutines.name: draw_view_1
subroutines.title: Draw the top-right view
subroutines.description: Draw the room in hero 1's view.

subroutines.name: draw_view_2
subroutines.title: Draw the bottom-left view
subroutines.description: Draw the room in hero 2's view.

subroutines.name: draw_view_3
subroutines.title: Draw the bottom-right view
subroutines.description: Draw the room in hero 3's view.

subroutines.name: draw_room
subroutines.title: Draw a room
subroutines.description: Draw the eight rows of walls of the room at &7B, &7C (a pointer into room_walls) with its top-left at plot_y and the column in cell_x, then draw the doors.

on_entry.map_ptr: the room's offset in room_walls (the low byte)

subroutines.name: draw_room_row
subroutines.title: Draw one row of a room
subroutines.description: Plot a wall or a blank for each of the eight bits of scratch, four byte columns apart, starting at byte column cell_x.

on_entry.scratch: the row's eight wall bits, the leftmost cell in bit 7

subroutines.name: plot_at_cell
subroutines.title: Plot a sprite at a map cell in every view
subroutines.description: Plot sprite_number at map cell cell_x, cell_y, shifted by the pixel offsets in &7D, &7E, in each view that shows the cell's room. Cells are four byte columns wide and twelve pixel rows high.

subroutines.name: test_wall
subroutines.title: Test for a wall at a map cell
subroutines.description: Return the room_walls bit for cell cell_x, cell_y: non-zero if there is a wall. Also leaves &7B, &7C pointing at the cell's room.

subroutines.name: test_object_free
subroutines.title: Test whether a map cell can hold an object
subroutines.description: Return the object_free_map bit for cell cell_x, cell_y: zero if an object may lie there.

on_exit.Z: set if an object may lie there

subroutines.name: find_creature
subroutines.title: Look for a monster or hero at a cell
subroutines.description: Look for a monster, other than monster number scratch, at cell_x, cell_y. If scratch is non-zero, also look for a hero there, and if one is found take hero_damage_taken points of their health.

on_exit.Y: non-zero if a monster was found

subroutines.name: update_monsters
subroutines.title: Draw the trapdoors and move the monsters
subroutines.description: Draw the eight trapdoors, then for each monster continue its step or start a new one, turning a random way when it is blocked, and advance dying monsters until they reappear at a trapdoor.

subroutines.name: start_monster_step
subroutines.title: Start a monster's step between cells
subroutines.description: Set monster X's step counter to 3 and its pixel offsets to one step in its direction of travel: 3 rows up or down, or one byte column left or right.

subroutines.name: continue_monster_step
subroutines.title: Continue a monster's step between cells
subroutines.description: Toggle monster X's frame and count down its step. When it ends, move the monster one cell on and clear its offsets; otherwise grow the offsets by another column or three rows.

subroutines.name: test_key
subroutines.title: Test whether a key is pressed
subroutines.description: Scan the key whose INKEY number is in A with OSBYTE &81.

on_entry.A: INKEY key number (negative, as a byte)

on_exit.A: 0 if the key is pressed, 1 if not
on_exit.Z: set if the key is pressed

subroutines.name: play_level
subroutines.title: Play a level until it ends
subroutines.description: Run one frame every three vertical syncs: check for victory and update the game, take any hero standing on the exit down it, and animate one going down. Return when no hero is in play and every death animation has finished. Each hero_enters_exit leaves its return address on the stack (it ends with a jump back here), so the first RTS at the end of a level returns into this loop, once for each hero who left by the exit, before the last returns to the caller.

subroutines.name: game_entry
subroutines.title: Start the game
subroutines.description: Set the bell sound (the BEL character's channel, envelope, pitch and duration), save WRCHV in saved_wrchv and point WRCHV at wrch_handler. The code here is run once only: from &0D40 its bytes are then reused as the missile tables and other workspace in page &0D, which reset_workspace refreshes for each level. It does not return: it starts a new game.

subroutines.name: decrypt_level
subroutines.title: Decrypt and check the level just loaded
subroutines.description: Decrypt the level at &6B00-&6DAF in place, XORing each byte with the low byte of its own address, and sum the decrypted bytes. If the sum does not match the level's entry in level_checksums, reset the machine.

subroutines.name: decrypt_level_joystick
subroutines.title: Decrypt and check the level just loaded
subroutines.description: Decrypt the level at &6B00-&6DAF in place, XORing each byte with the low byte of its own address, and sum the decrypted bytes. If the sum does not match the level's entry in level_checksums, reset the machine.

subroutines.name: start_level
subroutines.title: Set up and draw a new level
subroutines.description: Show the level number, load and unpack the level, reset the workspace and monsters, then clear the text area, set the screen to its full 25-row height and draw the view frames and views.

subroutines.name: boot_loader
subroutines.title: Load the game file and run it (not used)
subroutines.description: Build an OSFILE control block at &6B00 naming boot_filename with load address &2000, call the filing system's FILEV handler to load the file, and jump to &2000. &0740 is the execution address in the *SAVE command left at &0700, so this is the image's own entry point when it is *RUN, but nothing in this release reaches it.

subroutines.name: boot_loader_joystick
subroutines.title: Load the game file and run it (not used)
subroutines.description: Point BYTEV at joystick_bytev (&0780), then build an OSFILE control block at &6B00 naming boot_filename with load address &2000, call the filing system's FILEV handler to load the file, and jump to &2000. &0740 is the execution address in the *SAVE command left at &0700, so this is the image's own entry point when it is *RUN, but nothing in this release reaches it.

subroutines.name: coder_start
subroutines.title: Coder: load the game and the next level
subroutines.description: Run with *RUN CODER at the start of every level. Count the level, reload Dun1 (which contains this code, so the bytes being run are rewritten with identical ones), load the level file at &6B00 (level 25 comes from the end of Stones), copy one of the two &0400-&07FF images and the &08C0-&1FFF image into place, and enter the game.

subroutines.name: next_level_by_reset
subroutines.title: Move on to the next level by resetting the machine
subroutines.description: Set the BREAK intercept to next_level_intercept and jump to the MOS 1.20 reset entry.

subroutines.name: restart_by_reset
subroutines.title: Restart the game by resetting the machine
subroutines.description: Set the BREAK intercept to restart_intercept and reset the machine.

subroutines.name: restart_intercept
subroutines.title: BREAK intercept: reload the game
subroutines.description: Called by the MOS during the reset. On the second call (carry set) clear the screen and issue *DISC and *DUNJUNZ.

on_entry.C: set on the second call, after the filing system is initialised

subroutines.name: next_level_intercept
subroutines.title: BREAK intercept: run Coder for the next level
subroutines.description: Called by the MOS during the reset. On the second call (carry set) select MODE 2 and issue *DISC and *RUN CODER.

on_entry.C: set on the second call, after the filing system is initialised

subroutines.name: check_level
subroutines.title: Check the level and set the text window
subroutines.description: Decrypt and check the level (Coder has already loaded it), and set the bottom row used by clear_text_area.

subroutines.name: joystick_bytev
subroutines.title: BYTEV handler: read a joystick for the third player's keys
subroutines.description: Installed by Coder, in the joystick image of &0400-&07FF only. Answers OSBYTE &81 scans of the third player's keys from the analogue port: left (&98) and right (&97) from channel 1 at its extremes, up (&B9) and down (&99) from channel 2, and fire (&9D) from the fire buttons. Every other call goes to the MOS 1.20 OSBYTE routine at &E772 directly.

on_exit.X: &FF if the key is pressed, 0 if not

subroutines.name: show_level_number
subroutines.title: Clear the text area before a level
subroutines.description: Coder has already shown the level number, so this only clears the text area.

banners.title: Heroes' starting attributes
banners.description: Four tables of one byte per hero (Ranger, Magic-User, Barbarian, Fighter): missiles in flight, missile damage, health lost per hit, and the face sprite for the panel.

banners.name: game_over_message

banners.description: Eleven lines of seventeen characters, each ended by a carriage return, then a line feed and a last line ended by a zero byte. Two bytes of it (&0FF1, &0FF2) double as counters, and are overwritten with spaces before printing, so the full stop after "YOU ALL" never appears.

banners.description: Leftover bytes: "ND!" and a zero, the end of an earlier message, then "&C2".

banners.title: Font: letters A-Z
banners.description: Eight bytes per letter, copied into the definition of character 128 by the WRCHV handler.

banners.name: font_digits
banners.title: Font: digits 0-9
banners.description: Eight bytes per digit, copied into the definition of character 128 by the WRCHV handler.

banners.name: view_frame_plots
banners.title: View frame PLOT commands
banners.description: Twenty five-byte VDU 25 commands (plot code, x, y) sent by draw_view_frames.

banners.title: Sprite tables
banners.description: Four tables of 120 entries, indexed by sprite number: data address low bytes, high bytes, widths in bytes and heights in rows.

memory_map.description: MOS 1.20: A at the last interrupt, read by dissolve_chalice to vary its random choice.

memory_map.description: MOS 1.20 counter decremented on every vertical sync interrupt. The game sets it and waits for it to run out to pace itself.

memory_map.name: level_digits
